move: mark drops and lands with squash, M draws on, wordmark slides out from behind while lockup recenters
how: A flex lockup of a mint rounded-square SVG mark with an M stroke and a masked wordmark 'acme.' whose overflow container hides the text. The lockup starts offset by half the name width so the mark alone is centred. 0-23%: the mark drops from y -220 rotating -18 (move), at 18% it squashes scaleY .9/scaleX 1.08 and settles with elastic.out(1,.4); at 8% the M drawSVGs 0->100% (power2.inOut). At 27% the name slides from xPercent -125 out from behind the mark (expo.out, 0.8s) while the lockup x eases from nameW/2 to 0 so the pair ends centred. Exit at 78%: the name retracts to -125 and the lockup shifts back (expo.in, 0.45s); at 88% the mark drops down out to y 220 rotating 18 (power3.in).
adapt: Replace the mark SVG and its path, the mint (#7cf5c1), the wordmark text and the accent character. Keep the 0.7s expo.out drop, the elastic landing and the 0.8s recentering slide.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the lockup inside el and measures the .mask offsetWidth after fonts load; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the drop at 0, the slide at 0.27D-0.53D, the retract at 0.78D. Scope '.lockup', '.mark', '.m1', '.name' to el; the from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested; the initial set of lockup x depends on measured width so mount must run after layout.
caveats: nameW is measured from offsetWidth at script time; fonts must be loaded first or the centring is off
